plugin.name: WB Listora
notes: 1.6.0 delta (targeted, agent-enumerated): +3 fired hooks (wb_listora_require_terms_acceptance, wb_listora_before/after_related_listings). +3 public template helpers: wb_listora_render_icon(), wb_listora_get_icon_choices(), wb_listora_get_review_criteria(). +1 public static Lucide_Icons::get_names(). +1 post meta _listora_terms_accepted (written by submit_listing). Search args gain 'tags' (REST arg on /search, consumed by Search_Engine::filter_taxonomies and wb_listora_search_args_from_url). Facets gain a 'tag' group. wb_listora_get_listing_cards() featured_image gains medium_large + thumbnail keys and 'medium' now means WP's 300px medium. Card payload gains 'tags'. .listora-tag-badge promoted from blocks/listing-detail/style.css to src/components/badge.css (shared: listing-detail + listing-card).

1.6.0 automation-triggers wave (Task 11 targeted delta, hand-authored -- never run the deterministic generator per this file's own manifest-refresh-strategy note): new includes/automation/ subsystem. Trigger_Registry (service key 'triggers', behind \WBListora\Contracts\Trigger_Registry_Interface) -- register()/all()/get()/has()/names(), validates the 7 required keys (name/label/group/hook/capability/version/schema), the 6 string keys must actually be strings, version a positive int, duplicate names refused (first registration wins). Schema_Loader -- dir()/dirs()/path()/load(); dirs() is filter-extensible via wb_listora_automation_schema_dirs (Free's own directory always first and undisplaceable); path() refuses anything but ^[a-z0-9_]+\.v[0-9]+\.json$ (path-traversal guard). Payload -- listing()/review()/claim()/user(), each a pure passthrough to the REST API's own row/card serializers (wb_listora_get_listing_cards(), Reviews_Controller::format_review_row(), Claims_Controller::format_claim_row()), so a listing/review/claim in a webhook is byte-identical to the same entity via the shared card endpoints (/search, /favorites, /listings/{id}/related) -- NOT identical to GET /listings/{id}'s own richer detail shape, which is a different, intentionally uncoupled endpoint. Trigger_Definitions declares Free's 25-trigger catalogue (6 groups: listing x10, reviews x2, claims x3, members x5, favourites x2, services x3) then fires wb_listora_register_triggers so Pro/add-ons can declare into the same registry before wb_listora_loaded. New global template-helper wrappers in class-template-helpers.php: wb_listora_automation_payload_listing()/_review()/_claim()/_user() -- the documented public surface Pro consumes (INV-3), never Payload's internal namespace directly. 26 new schema files under includes/automation/schemas/ (*.v1.json) -- 25 map one-to-one onto Free's 25 triggers; the 26th, coupon_redeemed.v1.json, is the schema for PRO's coupon_redeemed trigger, which reuses Free's copy rather than shipping a duplicate because Free's schema directory is always searched first and cannot be displaced (Schema_Loader::dirs()). New bin/audit-guardrails.sh stages G12 (every dispatched webhook event name is a registered trigger -- fails the build if a Pro dispatch_event() call has no matching registry entry), G14 (every registered trigger's 'schema' key resolves to a real file on disk, checked across both Free's and Pro's schema directories), G15 (a schema file already published at origin/main can never be edited in place, in either repo -- the only escape is adding a new versioned file and repointing the trigger's schema+version; no G13, reserved for the separate actions-catalogue plan). Service registration in class-plugin.php::register_services() -- Service_Locator::register('triggers', ...) runs, then Trigger_Definitions::register_all() runs, both before wb_listora_loaded fires, so Pro can resolve and declare into the registry at its own boot. hooks_fired 308 -> 313: +1 action (wb_listora_register_triggers) and +1 filter (wb_listora_automation_schema_dirs) from this wave, PLUS a pre-existing 3-entry undercount in the declared count field found and fixed while making this edit (the real hooks_fired array was already 311 long before either new hook was added -- hooks_fired_count now equals array length exactly, both here and going forward).

Pro's lead_form takes /listings/{id}/contact (different route); the two never render together — Contact_Form::should_render() bails when wb_listora_pro_feature_enabled('lead_form') returns true.

Stage an uploaded CSV and queue a resumable, idempotent background import on the canonical Background_Import engine. Returns the run_id the admin UI polls against /import/progress/{run_id}. Mirrors Import_Export_Controller::import_csv validation (file presence, MIME allowlist, mapping decode) so both import paths reject the same malformed input. Self-registered inside Background_Import on wb_listora_rest_api_init (1.2.0 wave-4).
Poll background demo/CSV import progress (1.2.0 wave-4; admin-gated)

endpoints.permission: __return_true (public by design — signed HMAC token uid|event vs wp_salt('wb_listora_unsubscribe') is the credential; RFC 8058 one-click opt-out, hash_equals compare)
endpoints.purpose: One-click email unsubscribe for marketing/nudge notification events; flips _listora_notify_{event} user meta and renders an HTML confirmation page (1.2.0). NOTE: GET only — earlier audit notes claiming GET/POST were wrong.

endpoints.permission: logged-in; self-only (reads get_current_user_id, never an id from the request)
endpoints.purpose: Irreversible account deletion (Apple 5.1.1(v)). Requires confirm=DELETE. Runs the erasure map, then wp_delete_user(). Listings trashed by default.
Reversible. Hides the profile and unpublishes listings but RETAINS all data so a paying customer can be restored.
Restores a deactivated account, returning each listing to its PRIOR status (not a hardcoded publish, which would bypass moderation).

Trade a member's WordPress password for a core Application Password. Anonymous by necessity (the caller has no credential yet); guarded by the wb_listora_app_password_login owner switch, a TLS gate, dual ip:/user: failure lockouts checked BEFORE any credential is read, and uniform 401s so it cannot enumerate accounts. Answers 409 rather than bypassing an interactive second factor.

hooks_fired.name: wb_listora_bg_import_use_async

Returning false forces the synchronous fallback (the canonical engine also runs inline when Action Scheduler is unavailable or the item count is at/below SYNC_THRESHOLD=10). Lets hosts opt tiny packs out of a cron round-trip or force inline draining for debugging.

F10 import-canonicalization (1.2.0 wave-4): \WBListora\ImportExport\Background_Import (includes/import-export/class-background-import.php) is the CANONICAL import engine. Every bulk import path routes through it: demo packs via queue_demo() (Setup Wizard class-setup-wizard.php:794, Settings class-settings-page.php:2803), file imports via queue_file() and the self-registered POST /import/queue/csv route (rest_queue_csv), progress via GET /import/progress/{run_id} (rest_progress). THE single interpretation of _listora_business_hours meta (1.5.0). The meta has carried three shapes (legacy list, the day-keyed dict the form used to post, and the current `ranges` split-shift shape). Five readers each had their own interpretation and four were wrong; every one failed SILENTLY — storage correct, one surface blank, no error anywhere. static_utilities.purpose: How many time ranges one day may hold (1.5.0). Global rather than a class constant so Pro's importers and theme template overrides can call it without naming a Free internal class (INV-3). Delegates to Search_Indexer::max_hours_slots().
static_utilities.consumers: submission hours builder (read off data attributes, so the JS owns no limit and no English string), importers, indexer

static_utilities.purpose: Resolves the site's default listing type slug (1.5.0), '' when unset or unusable. Stored as ONE site setting (wb_listora_settings.default_listing_type), NOT per-type term meta — so "only one type can be default" is true by construction rather than an invariant needing re-enforcement on every save (which can drift to two defaults or none). The default PRE-SELECTS but never hides the Type step; $listing_type is what hides it, so folding the default into it would lock every submitter on a multi-type site into one type.

Sanitize callback for the map_location field (1.5.0) — owns the nested child-key list (address, lat, lng, city, state, country, postal_code) that the renderer posts and get_rest_schema() declares. Added when EVERY wp-admin listing save was silently erasing address, coordinates, city, state and country and deleting the wp_listora_geo row, dropping the listing off the map and out of distance search: the admin save handler read seven FLAT keys no renderer has ever emitted, and the seventh (meta_address) was an array (string)-cast to "Array", which 1.4.1's sanitize_json() correctly refuses — so 1.4.1 turned "stores garbage" into "silently erases". The metabox's duplicate composite special case is DELETED, not corrected: duplicated shape knowledge caused the bug, so map_location now flows the generic sanitize path.
static_utilities.consumers: Field sanitize dispatch (includes/core/class-field.php:294), admin metabox save, REST submission + update
